fluff.overview: Caesar's ongoing program to modernize the Legiones Marianes has extended to conventional infantry formations, with improved equipment and weapons gradually replacing older stockpiles across the Hegemony's auxiliary legions. A centuria, or century, is the Marian equivalent of a company-sized formation. Mechanized wheeled centuries use wheeled transports that offer good road speed and lower maintenance costs than tracked vehicles, well suited to the Hegemony's infrastructure-limited Periphery worlds where supply lines stretch thin. Support elements carry man-portable short-range missile launchers firing the same warheads used by BattleMechs, giving the formation a potent anti-armor punch at close range.
